analysis_coverage.aggregation: arithmetic mean of all hourly source contributions

replay_selection.criterion: maximum mean circular direction variation across nine locations among UTC-midnight 48h windows, excluding calm directions; independent of intervention outcomes

limitations: Relative screening index, not pollutant concentration, personal exposure or health risk.
Annual satellite-estimated gas volume implies constant activity; no pollutant factor or hourly operation observations.
Uniform tract-area population allocation in prepared 5 km cells; not observed home locations.
Nine coarse ERA5 weather locations; nearest location assigned in EPSG:32614.
Calm winds below 0.5 m/s use an isotropic screening convention with uncertain direction.
30 km cutoff, finite source domain and uncalibrated kernel omit transport beyond study sources.
Wind vectors use meteorological true east/north directions directly on UTM coordinates; local grid convergence is not corrected.
